role: The ingestion and caching tier of the pipeline: it turns GS internal market data services into per-symbol parquet caches that everything downstream consumes. `chunk_store.py` pulls raw L1 trade and quote ticks for the 34 symbol universe from Chunk Store via pytickclient, plus L2 order book depth for the E-mini S&P 500, and rolls the front ES futures contract on the Thursday before the third Friday of each expiry month.

`rv_panel.py` distills those ticks into the daily [[realized variance]] panel through a streaming batch pipeline: trading calendar, batched fetch, per-day RV computation, checkpoint to parquet, release. Peak memory stays bounded to one sub-batch of tick data at a time, so a multi-year backfill survives on a workstation and resumes from its checkpoint instead of starting over.

`micro.py` works below the daily grain: server-classified ticks become 10 second signed-volume bars, from which it computes daily aggregates, signed volume ratio, order flow imbalance, and [[VPIN]] per Easley, Lopez de Prado and O'Hara 2012, plus per-bar sequences for the LSTM and TCN models. Cache writes are atomic and merging, never destructive, and a staging directory lets an interrupted ingest resume where it stopped.
reads: Raw L1 and L2 ticks and server-aggregated 5-min bars from Chunk Store via pytickclient, a GS internal tick service reachable only with a live pyslang session.
feeds: Daily RV panels feed the feature layers, 10 second bar sequences feed the LSTM and TCN models, and the CLI ingest commands drive its caches; at fan-in 8 it is one of the most imported modules in the repo.
